title: Migrate betterado_dashboard + betterado_extension to terraform-plugin-framework
essence: Both betterado_dashboard and betterado_extension are now served by terraform-plugin-framework via the mux provider. Schemas are unchanged; ForceNew, Computed, and Optional semantics preserved. Gap matrices document every ADO API field's coverage status. Provider no longer registers either resource in the SDKv2 ResourcesMap.

checkpoints.afterNote: Gate green after dashboard + extension framework migration; ok release, ok taskagent, ok taskagent/validate
